items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Brew Moore and I used to play in front of the band.

ctx.x: And that was in the Forties. What can you say about that whole thing?
Oh, that was great. Playing with Machito was very nice, because he had a hell of a band at that period at that time. Brew Moore and I used to play in front of the band.
